title: The GEM Benchmark: Natural Language Generation, its Evaluation and Metrics

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance on subsets of the ToTTo dataset split by the gender of the subject (male vs. female) using WikiData metadata.
Comparing model performance on subsets of the ToTTo dataset split by the continent of the subject's nationality using WikiData metadata.
Comparing model performance on subsets of the ToTTo dataset, specifically contrasting African Americans against all Americans, using WikiData metadata.
Evaluating model performance across 18 different languages using multilingual datasets (e.g., WikiLingua, MLSum, WebNLG) to assess disparities compared to English-centric performance.
